catalyst_precursor.coordination: Dimer; two chlorides bridge the two Rh centers; each Rh bears two terminal CO ligands coordinated through carbon.

observations: The connectivities of P1 and P2 define the known reaction types to be explained; quantitative yield/distribution data are not available for this simplified substrate.
model_note: The substrate is an O-linked model with two methyl groups at the allene terminus; its numerical results must not be equated with those of the larger experimental substrates.

target_stereochemistry.identity_status: Supplied relative configuration, not a stereoselectivity prediction target.
